examples.label: PEDV in China
examples.blurb: Discrete phylogeography of porcine epidemic diarrhea virus across Chinese provinces, with BSSVS multi-state ancestors.

examples.label: Yellow Fever virus in Brazil
examples.blurb: Continuous phylogeography of Yellow Fever virus across Brazilian states (Faria et al.). Multi-modal HPD polygons; secondary traits ecoregion and host_type drive Style panel color/glyph.

examples.label: SARS-CoV-2 B.1.1.7 (Alpha) in the UK
examples.blurb: Continuous phylogeography of SARS-CoV-2 Alpha lineage across the UK (reprojected EPSG:27700 → WGS84). ~17k tips — the v1.0 performance ceiling fixture.
